column1: # Tile patches: labels drawn as BITMAPS rather than text characters.
# The status bar has its own 26-tile mini-font at bank 2 $7C92 (digits, Lv, F, Hp, /,
# %, the meter block, then the fullness label). The label is a compressed bitmap that
# spans tile boundaries rather than sitting one character per cell, so the budget is
# PIXELS of strip width, not characters.
